description: Deal damage to a character (narrative/environmental, not from combat resolution). Floors HP at 0 and reports defeat; in worlds with Health and Wounds, reaching 0 Health deals a Wound (rolled on the wound table) and `wounds` deals Wounds directly. For combat attacks, use `attack`. For combat-target damage, use `apply_damage`.

amount.description: Damage to deal. HP stops at 0; in worlds with Health and Wounds, reaching 0 Health deals a Wound.

damageType.description: Kind of damage: picks the wound table in worlds with Health and Wounds (the world's default otherwise)

wounds.description: Wounds dealt directly, skipping Health (worlds with Health and Wounds)

name: damage_character
